query:
-- Delete all Paloma2 (w/ Display) milestones across all types
DELETE FROM milestones
WHERE product = 'Paloma2 (w/ Display)';

-- Delete RBM2 Refresh Product Commit specifically
DELETE FROM milestones
WHERE product LIKE '%RBM2 Refresh%'
AND milestone_name LIKE '%Product Commit%'
AND milestone_type = 'pdp_gates';
